name: Hapa Card Relationship Lab
summary: App-specific Hapa protocol board for the Card Card relationship cockpit built from the 3D card table prototype.

columns.label: Backlog
columns.intent: Known work not yet ready for an agent.

columns.label: Ready
columns.intent: Scoped work with enough context to start.

columns.label: Blocked
columns.intent: Work that needs a decision, dependency, or external state change.

columns.label: Review
columns.intent: Ready for Overwatch/user review and integration check.

actors.label: Green
actors.role: UI, operator workflow, QA, demo state.

actors.label: Human
actors.role: Project owner, reviewer, and priority authority.

sourceTruthHierarchy: Hapa dev proto card model and card detail notes
protocol.recordRule: Every app build action, source review, design decision, verification, and follow-up is appended as an event. The board is derived from the event log.
protocol.safeActionPolicy: The first prototype uses source-anchored static graph data. Live database export and writeback actions require explicit scoped follow-up.
